title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC tagged $79,100 overnight (first sub-$80K print in current drawdown), recovered to ~$80,500 (-0.22% 24h).
FOMC week: rate decision Wed Oct 28 (hold ~81% priced); Q3 GDP + Sep PCE Thu Oct 29 — two major risk events in 24h.
Dashboard API unreachable this run (DNS failure); price change thresholds unverifiable via live feed.
